# Let's Play

> Let's Play is the Isle of Man's leading football development centre for boys and girls, offering after-school football programmes and school-holiday football camps, with over 150 children taking part in weekly programmes.

Let's Play was founded in 2024 on the Isle of Man. Coaching is led by UEFA B and C Licence-qualified coaches. Let's Play also runs a Free Child Initiative (launched 2025) providing funded places for families facing financial difficulties, and has raised over £15,000 for local Isle of Man charities, including Rebecca House, the Island's children's hospice.

## Programmes

- [Football Programmes](https://letsplay.co.im/programmes/football): Open-access after-school football programme for boys and girls in school years 1 to 6.
- [Full Throttle Programmes](https://letsplay.co.im/programmes/full-throttle): Open-access, higher-intensity development programme for school years 3 to 9.
- [Gold Programmes](https://letsplay.co.im/programmes/gold): Invite-only pathway for more advanced players, including a girls-only group for years 5 to 9.
- [All Programmes](https://letsplay.co.im/programmes)

## Football Camps

- [Football Camps](https://letsplay.co.im/football-camps): School-holiday football camps run every half-term and the summer holidays.
